facts.fact: Kunal asks 'What did the letter say?' in spite of his promise; his fingertips whiten and blue under the nails, the rope draws taut, and he holds his hands in view and says 'I'll pay it.' The chill drains over time. Ila refuses (a free silence), citing her archive oath sworn before this crossing. Replaces F550; no 'leave' device exists.
Ila sews her exits sheet and three older sheets (Stair and Moon) into the side-seam lining of her pattu, above the hem; the queen's letter lies in the hem below them. Replaces F552's wording.
